moment.nsmotionusagedescription.zh-Hans: 在您开始运动后读取本机步数，用于散步、慢跑等运动记录。
moment.nsmotionusagedescription.en: Linko Moment uses motion data to count steps during your exercise sessions.

moment.nscamerausagedescription.zh-Hans: 扫描孩子手表的二维码以填写配对码并确认绑定。
moment.nscamerausagedescription.en: Linko Moment uses the camera to scan watch pairing QR codes.

moment.nslocationwheninuseusagedescripti.zh-Hans: 在活动打卡或搜索附近餐厅时获取位置；在您开启运动地图模式后记录轨迹，完成后随运动记录同步到当前账号。
moment.nslocationwheninuseusagedescripti.en: Use location for activity check-ins or nearby dining searches. When you enable workout map mode, record your route and sync completed workouts privately to your account.
